description: Default capabilities for the BIG Hat Entertainment shell. Intentionally minimal — we only add fine-grained perms when a real-world feature needs them. See lib.rs alpha.3 incident: invalid perm names panic the Builder before setup() runs, killing the windows-subsystem process silently. alpha.48: added core:webview + core:window:allow-create/set-* so PresentationMode.openAudienceView() can spawn the second window via @tauri-apps/api/webviewWindow. alpha.61: added `remote.urls` for 127.0.0.1/localhost. The shell navigates the main window to the sidecar at http://127.0.0.1:<port>/, which Tauri 2 treats as REMOTE; without remote.urls every IPC call (incl. creating the audience window) is denied and the app fell back to window.open -> 'allow pop-ups'. Audience windows (trivia/bingo/karaoke) must be native windows.
